kg_child_context_reason: sd_data_master has no child modules in DEPENDENCY_CONTEXT, and the generated fragments implement internal FSM/control logic rather than instantiating or wiring submodules. KG child context would not materially help the merge.
code_gap_notes: The module skeleton only contains commented port hints, so the merge needs authoritative input/output port names, widths, and directions.
Generated fragments declare and drive output-named registers directly; merge must resolve output ownership and avoid conflicting sequential and combinational drivers.
bd_cnt is conditionally declared in the parameter fragment, while other registers are declared separately; merge needs the external-width rules for RAM_MEM_WIDTH_16/32, READ_CYCLE, and BD_EMPTY.
The FSM next-state fragment depends on exact state encodings and transition conditions, including BD availability, command response, transfer failure, and stop handling.
The sequential fragment includes reset, BD loading, command setup, retry, status, and transfer-complete behavior that must be reconciled with the intended FSM_OUT semantics.

S005 is required as the current module output interface block, defining output ports, widths, and externally visible ownership.
